import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Convert Dt_Customer to datetime
df['Dt_Customer'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Dt_Customer'], format='%d-%m-%Y')

# Plot: Average spending by education level
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
spending_columns = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
df['Total_Spending'] = df[spending_columns].sum(axis=1)
avg_spending_by_education = df.groupby('Education')['Total_Spending'].mean().sort_values()

sns.barplot(x=avg_spending_by_education.index, y=avg_spending_by_education.values, palette='viridis')
plt.title('Average Total Spending by Education Level')
plt.xlabel('Education Level')
plt.ylabel('Average Total Spending')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
